independent_unit: Network; all six budget/precision strata paired within network
candidate: Include ensemble-greedy set and every endpoint-pair seed; fill a third slot by ensemble-risk greedy selection over all sites. Choose the smallest existing risk. Same criterion, added finite search candidates.
strong_baseline: Exact enumeration of all endpoint-only subsets at the same budget; separates search improvement from restricting attention to endpoints.
primary: endpoint_pair versus ensemble_greedy; network MSE first averaged equally over the six strata. Performance against endpoint_joint is a required additional comparator.
secondary: All individual strata, simple stimulus-first and random baselines; exact selection agreement, objective improvements and selection timing.
shared_inference: Nine common MAP starts, max_nfev 400; same observations for identical sets; no truth or measured data enter selection.
allocation_timing: Shared prior-bank construction reported separately; baseline greedy path computed to maximum budget and reused.
scope: Prospective application test of a mechanism-motivated search modification; no claim that enumeration, lookahead, or goal-oriented risk is new.
